**Noise schedule:** In the paper's framework, the VP model uses

σ(t) = √( e^{½ β_d t² + β_min t} − 1 )

This appears in the "Schedule" row of Table 1 (p. 3). It is derived in Appendix C.1.1 as Eq. 163 (p. 30), by substituting the VP SDE's drift and diffusion coefficients into the general formula for σ(t).

**Parameter values:** Table 1 gives β_d = 19.9 and β_min = 0.1 (p. 3). These come from Song et al.'s choices:
- β_d is defined as β_max − β_min (p. 30).
- Song et al. set β_min = 0.1 and β_max = 20 (p. 30).
- So β_d = 20 − 0.1 = 19.9.
